segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu.

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's dream proclamation and initial mandate
evidence: To the house its king spoke:
“I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth.
It was then, in a ‘dark goat’, that towards his king, on the lord Ningirsu, Gudea looked.
“Build his house!,” he ordered him.

segments.text_en: Gudea's epistemic uncertainty and resolve to consult Nanše
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant, counseled about the message:
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know.
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother.
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me.

segments.text_en: Barge journey and supplication to Ningirsu at Bagara
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water, he went to the king of Bagara, and prayed to him:
Ningirsu, let me build your house for you, let me make the ‘me’ perfect for you.
From Gudea, his offering and his prayer, his king, the lord Ningirsu, received from him.

segments.text_en: Supplication to Gatumdu for maternal protection and guidance
evidence: The governor set up his bed in the house of Gatumdu.
I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother. I am a no-father-haver, you are my father.
may your good Utukku go in front of me, may your good Lamma follow me on my path.
His lady, the offering and the prayer, Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea.

segments.text_en: Arrival at Siraran and recital of the dream vision to Nanše
evidence: In the courtyard of the deity of Siraran the governor raised the head to heaven,
Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven, his greatness was like the earth.
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand. She had the tablet of the stars on her lap.
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me.

segments.text_en: Nanše's hermeneutic decipherment and ritual instructions
evidence: His mother, Nanše, answered the governor: “My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you.
That is surely Nisaba, my sister.
after you decorated this chariot with purified silver and lapis,
He will reveal the plan of his house to you.

segments.text_en: Execution of divine gifts and entrance into Eninnu
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood.
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it.
to his king, lord Ningirsu, in Eninnu, the white Anzu, he enters.
Joyfully he entered to him in the house.

segments.text_en: Purification at Šugalam and plea for an explicit sign
evidence: To Šugalam, the terrible place, the place of rendering justice... the governor brought in.
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not.
your roaring, like cascading water, like a flood, your crushing of cities,
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, ‘heart’, son of Enlil, lord Ningirsu, I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's direct speech, cosmic self-revelation, and promise of prosperity
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house.
My house, Eninnu, founded by An, its ‘me’ is bigger than all the other enormous ‘me’
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive.
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign.”

segments.text_en: Awakening, extispicy confirmation, and civic purification of Lagash
evidence: Gudea rose, it was a dream. He is afraid, it was a dream.
He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good.
A mother does not accuse a son, accusations, a son to his mother does not speak.
The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire.

segments.text_en: Sanctification of the building platform and divine assembly
evidence: He laid down the goat by the box, the mold, he made the brick appear by the goat,
(For the) platform, he cleanses 24 ‘iku’ of the city for him, he purifies the platform for him.
Juniper, the pure plant of the mountain, he placed on the fire,
The Anunna of area-Lagash... stood with him.

segments.text_en: Civic levy and foreign assembly of labor and tribute
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, in the totality of all of his lands.
in the ‘tribe’ of Ningirsu, he made a levy for him.
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa.
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him.

segments.text_en: Expeditions to distant lands for cedar, stone, and metals
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
He cut down its cedars with the great axe.
To the land of stone, where no man enters, Gudea for the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper, (that) revealed itself to him,

segments.text_en: Nocturnal vigilance, divine architecture, and site surveying
evidence: he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight, he does not set his head to sleep during midday.
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him. Enki made the plan of the house right for him.
the field was right, he measured it, he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself.
Utu went up for him in abundance.

segments.text_en: Ritual molding and blessing of the first destiny-brick
evidence: The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, he raised to Eninnu.
Gudea placed clay in the mold. The cultic order emerged.
He shook the mold, he threw the brick to dry.
He placed the brick, he brought the mold into the house, he lifted the brick from the mold,

segments.text_en: Devotional concern, omen verification, and divine confirmation
evidence: Like a young man building a new house, he does not allow sweet sleep to enter his eyes.
Like a cow whose eye are on its calf, he walked to the house in great concern.
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good.
Gudea lying by the top, he slept, the word dawned on him.

segments.text_en: Laying the foundation and pronouncing the seven cosmic blessings
evidence: Enki places the foundation of the house, Nanše, the daughter of Eridu cared for the omen taking.
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground, he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax.
For the third (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? It is Anzu spreading its wings over the calfs.
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land.

segments.text_en: Raising the walls, door installations, and cosmic elevation
evidence: They place the wood of the door. It is the green sky lifting the crown.
They make the house grow like a mountain. They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud.
The governor built the house, he made it grow, he made it grow like a large mountain,
He placed the ‘multitude-eraser’, like a great sign, with Lagash

segments.text_en: Carving, naming, and erecting the six commemorative stelas
evidence: His large stones brought in their blocks, he brought them in a single year, he worked them in a single year,
‘the stela, king filling the courtyard, Lord Ningirsu made Gudea known from Girnun,’ as name of that stone he named.
‘the King, roaring storm of Enlil, lord no-haver of rival, Lord Ningirsu, Gudea, in his shiny ‘heart’ called him,’ as name of that stone he named.
‘Eninnu, knowing the face of An, Baba, life of Gudea,’ as name of that stone he named.

segments.text_en: Architectural perfection, cosmic radiance, and sanctuary banquets
evidence: He build the house of his king with righteousness. The righteous shepherd Gudea made it grow together with heaven and earth.
Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu, made it grow like a mountain of Lapis,
They prepare the meal in the great sanctuary, it is gold bowls filled with honey and wine,
He built, and after he had finished it, it is the ‘heart’ of the gods, returned to its banks.

segments.text_en: Installation of captured warrior trophies, mythical beasts, and door guardians
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there.
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place,
The cedar doors standing in the house, it is Iškur roaring from heaven.
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, like a garment, it covered.

segments.text_en: Furnishing the ritual wings, economic storehouses, and awe of Eninnu
evidence: The house, founded by Anu with purified silver, decorated with good perfume,
From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries, From the mighty oven, large cakes, large croissants(!?).
The inner room of harps, (called) ‘ox roaring princely’.
The big fear of the house rests on the land. Its praise reaches the mountains.

segments.text_en: Consecration, builder's attribution, and closing doxology to Ningirsu
evidence: The house (was) built in joy by its king. Ningešzida built it on a big place.
Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation.
Temple--going out in the land, standing outside in the dust like a big ox,
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised! The building of the house of Ningirsu, this is the middle of the praise.
